__meta: REUSABLE. Single-call trace. Azure Monitor Logs union of IVR (App Insights) + ACS (Log Analytics) + D365 (Traces), ordered timeline for one $e2e call (reuses Azure/Queries/single-call-trace.kql). Table — the E2E pane's flagship panel, promoted to a shared panel so any dashboard can drop in a drill-down.
title: Single-call trace (e2e.call_id = $e2e)
description: Everything that happened on call $e2e, in order, across ACS, the IVR, and D365. Set the $e2e dashboard variable to a canonical e2e.call_id.
